overall_goal: Check the doneness of the cooked lentils and add water to continue cooking if necessary

goals.description: Set aside the pressure cooker to release pressure and open its lid to inspect the contents
goals.rationale: The person moves the pressure cooker to let it cool down, then opens the lid and looks inside to check the cooked ingredients.

goals.description: Test the doneness of the kidney beans by mashing them
goals.rationale: The person uses a spoon to scoop out some kidney beans and presses them with their fingers to ensure they are completely cooked and soft.

goals.description: Add water to the pressure cooker and return it to the stove
goals.rationale: The person takes the pressure cooker to the sink to add tap water, then closes the lid and places it back on the gas stove flame.
